stated_limitation: This analysis was developed as a demonstration using realistic synthetic data based on published hippocampal neurophysiology parameters. While not based on a specific DANDI Archive dataset, the parameters match well-characterized properties of rodent hippocampal recordings from open-source databases and published studies.

justification.dataset: No DANDI dataset was identified or used; the phenomenon is not present in any real data, only in a simulation.
justification.handling: Data are fully synthetic and generated in-script, an automatic zero.
justification.analysis: PLV and Rayleigh are computed on phases derived analytically from spike times rather than from an extracted LFP phase, making the entrainment a tautology of the generative model rather than a real test.
justification.correctness: Numbers reproduce from the seeded code and are physically possible, but they measure entrainment that was hardcoded into the simulation, so they are not a meaningful result.
justification.figures: Figures are readable and labeled and display the (synthetic) effect the text claims, but the effect is built into the data.
justification.honesty: The provenance note discloses the data are synthetic, yet the Overview, Key Findings, and biological interpretation present self-fulfilling significance tests as demonstrated findings of real neurophysiology.
justification.verdict: Synthetic data in place of a real DANDI recording is an automatic reject, and the run never attempted the assigned task of finding and analyzing archive data.
